【原文 English Original】
US South builds a rare earth supply chain - The Northern Miner
A crew examines samples from drilling at Rare Earths Americas’ Foothills project in Georgia. Credit: Rare Earths Americas
Posted By: Blair McBride November 6, 2026
Rare earth developers are turning to the U.S. South’s chemical plants, ports and mineral deposits to build a supply chain that can compete with China. Louisiana is drawing three processing ventures, while explorers in Georgia and elsewhere in the region look for deposits that could eventually supply them.
Aclara Resources (TSX: ARA) received a non-binding letter of interest in September for up to $750 million (C$1 billion) from the U.S. Export-Import Bank to finance its proposed Dynamo separation plant in Louisiana. The company plans to feed it with material from projects in Chile and Brazil.
“The market is being pushed by two sides,” Aclara CEO Ramón Barúa told The Northern Miner. “The Chinese continue to restrict the rare earths, and on the other side, the Western world continues to also try to limit their use of Chinese [rare earth] product. We are the centre of those two converging forces.”
The Gulf Coast offers ports to bring in feedstock and a chemical industry with the workers and suppliers to process it. The test is whether developers can secure financing and enough material to keep separation plants running reliably at commercial scale.
Aclara aims to start site preparation for its $494-million Dynamo plant in the first quarter of 2027, subject to financing. It targets construction completion in the second half of 2028. The site is at the Port of Vinton, about 340 km west of New Orleans.
Dynamo would process material from Aclara’s Penco project in Chile, whose first stage has environmental approval, and Carina in Brazil, which is awaiting environmental licences. Both host rare earths in shallow ionic clays that require no blasting, crushing or grinding, the company says.
Aclara is testing its separation technology at a demonstration plant in Blacksburg, Va. A second demonstration plant, which opened in Chile in October, is testing technology to make metals and alloys.
At full capacity, Dynamo could produce annual averages of about 1,300 tonnes of neodymium-praseodymium oxide, 200 tonnes of dysprosium oxide and 35 tonnes of terbium oxide, according to Aclara’s October engineering update. The company has added yttrium, gadolinium and samarium to its planned product range.
Canada’s Ucore Rare Metals (TSXV: UCU; US-OTC: UURAF) is installing equipment at its separation plant in Alexandria, La., and has secured $27 million in federal defence funding. ElementUSA plans to recover rare earths from bauxite residue at the Atlantic Alumina refinery in Gramercy, La. It received a $29.9-million defence award for gallium and scandium recovery and is part of a Colorado School of Mines-led project selected for negotiations over $67 million in Department of Energy funding.
Ucore and ElementUSA did not respond to requests for comment before this article was published in the November print issue of The Northern Miner.
Aclara chose Louisiana for access to chemical suppliers and to operators and contractors with petrochemical experience around Lake Charles, Barúa said.
Dynamo would use about 500 mixer-settlers, which separate metals using solvents. Material can take months to move through the system, so operators may wait a long time to see the effect of adjustments, Barúa said.
“The hardest part, by far, is operating these facilities,” he said. “Ramping up and then having stable production is going to be very, very difficult to attain.”
Processing the feedstock in Brazil and Chile before it reaches Louisiana should help stabilize separation at Dynamo, Barúa said. Aclara is using its pilot plant to gain operating experience before scaling up.
Aclara shares were 15% weaker at C$2.05 at Thursday’s close in Toronto, valuing the company at about C$601 million.
Rare Earths Americas (NYSE-A: REA) is drilling its Foothills project about 110 km southwest of Atlanta. The company also holds three projects in Brazil, including Alpha and Constellation, which have initial resources. Gina Rinehart’s Hancock Prospecting held about 6% of the explorer through subsidiary Hanrine Investments, according to a September filing.
The company is conducting a 25,000- to 30,000-metre drill program at Foothills and plans to release an initial resource in the first quarter of 2027, CEO Don Swartz told The Northern Miner.
The Gulf Coast’s ports and transport links allow processors to bring in concentrates while domestic mining projects advance, Swartz said.
“You’re seeing a cluster along the coast where you’re able to import concentrates and… process them,” he said. “The Gulf Coast, for instance, in the Texas area [has] good transportation and government support.”
Rare Earths Americas acquired Shiloh in July 2025 when it bought Australia’s Foothills Rare Earths. It outlined the 1,650-sq.-km Foothills district a year later, comprising Shiloh, Liberty Peak and three other targets. Land and access agreements remain to be finalized on some prospective ground.
Drill hole 25-DPLC-022 cut 10.2 metres grading 2.02% total rare earth oxides from surface, the company reported June 15. Mineralization occurs in saprolite clays and monazite-bearing sands. The project sits on private land and would require state approvals and potentially federal permits to develop.
Monazite from Foothills could potentially be processed at Energy Fuels’ (TSX: EFR; NYSE-A: UUUU) White Mesa mill in Utah or at the Saskatchewan Research Council’s plant in Saskatoon, Swartz said. White Mesa already uses monazite feed, including material from Chemours’ (NYSE: CC) operations in the South. It has produced neodymium-praseodymium oxide commercially and dysprosium and terbium oxides at pilot scale.
Elsewhere in the region, USA Rare Earth (Nasdaq: USAR) has a feasibility study under way at Round Top in Texas. IperionX (ASX: IPX) completed a feasibility study in June for its Titan project in Tennessee. Chemours extracts mineral sands containing rare earths in Florida and Georgia.
Rare Earths Americas shares were 12% weaker at $7.25 at Thursday’s close in New York, valuing the company at about $149 million based on the share count at print time.
“We’ve got a very large pack­age that we’re drilling out, and we see widespread mineralization,” Swartz said. “You start with the proof of concept and then you grow the resource every time.”

美国海军陆战队下士2026 年 8 月 25 日，在菲律宾博赫多尔举行的群岛海岸防御连续体 26.4 期间，第一海军陆战队远征军东南亚海军陆战队轮换部队北方空海军炮火联络连分遣队的一名火力支援海军陆战队员与菲律宾海军陆战队第四海军旅一起进行火力支援小组训练。该服务上周宣布，东南亚轮换力量目前正在第二次连续轮换到菲律宾。 MRF-SEA 于 10 月 26 日进行了轮换。MRF-SEA 最初是一支为期六个月的轮换部队，从 10 月到 3 月部署到该地区，但其任务在 4 月延长。应菲律宾政府邀请，该部队目前在菲律宾持续驻扎，以继续与菲律宾军方合作。 MRF-SEA 是在第一海军陆战队远征军支持下作战的两支轮换部队之一，另一支是海军陆战队轮换部队-达尔文。与作为海军陆战队空地特遣部队部署的 MRF-D 不同，MRF-SEA 部署为可扩展的特遣部队，其指挥总部是常设组成部分。其他海军陆战队单位将根据需要进行分配。我们。
2026 年 6 月 24 日，为支持 MRF-SEA 而部署的第三濒海战斗队、海军陆战队第三临海团、海军陆战队第三师的海军陆战队士兵和海军陆战队第四旅的菲律宾海军陆战队士兵，在菲律宾巴丹群岛伊特巴亚特的海上关键地形安全行动期间，在地形巡逻的同时参加城市地形军事行动，以支持 KAMANDAG 10。美国海军陆战队照片轮换前延期后，MRF-SEA 的指挥部门将根据预定活动的地点在东南亚国家之间移动。自四月份以来，指挥部门一直驻扎在菲律宾。目前的部署是 MRF-SEA 的第六次迭代。轮换部署于 2022 年开始。根据海军陆战队的一份新闻稿，该部队的存在旨在加强联合战备和美菲联盟，每次轮换都建立在之前部队的关系和经验教训的基础上，MRF-SEA 称之为“有目的的存在”。 “我们的目标从来都不是简单地出现在菲律宾，”即将卸任的 MRF-SEA 轮换指挥官罗伯特·邦恩 (Robert Bunn) 上校说。 “存在必须有目的。与我们的菲律宾盟友一起进行的每一次演习、计划会议和重复都是一个机会，让我们变得更加具有互操作性、响应能力和能力，并在每次活动中逐渐变得更好。
下一次轮换现在有机会吸取这些教训和关系，推动联盟向前迈进一步。”之前的 MRF-SEA 轮换中，该部队在“肩并肩 26”演习、“卡曼达格 10”演习以及通过群岛海岸防御连续体 (ACDC) 进行的一系列双边活动期间与菲律宾军队一起进行了训练。该连续体在主要演习之间提供了反复训练，使美国和菲律宾部队能够将一次活动中的经验教训应用到下一次活动中。 ACDC是一系列双边训练活动和主题专家交流，支持菲律宾海军陆战队的现代化努力和菲律宾海军陆战队的群岛海岸防御概念，同时加强美国和菲律宾军队之间的联合战备。

U.S. Marine Corps Cpl. Antwon Brooks, a fire support Marine with Air Naval Gunfire Liaison Company Detachment – North, Marine Rotational Force – Southeast Asia, I Marine Expeditionary Force, conducts fire support team training alongside Philippine marines with 4th Marine Brigade, Philippine Marine Corps, during Archipelagic Coastal Defense Continuum 26.4 in Bojeador, Philippines, Aug. 25, 2026. US Marine Corps photo Marine Rotational Force-Southeast Asia is now on its second continuous rotation to the Philippines, the service announced last week. MRF-SEA held a rotation turnover on Oct. 26. MRF-SEA originally began as a six-month rotational force that deployed to the region from October to March but its mission was extended in April . The force is now providing a continuous presence in the Philippines at the invitation of the country’s government to continue cooperation with its military. MRF-SEA is one of two rotational forces operating under the aegis of I Marine Expeditionary Force, with the other being Marine Rotational Force-Darwin. Unlike MRF-D, which deploys as a Marine Air-Ground Task Force, MRF-SEA deploys as a scalable task force with its command headquarters being the permanent component. Other Marine units are assigned as and when required. U.S. Marines assigned to 3rd Littoral Combat Team, 3rd Marine Littoral Regiment, 3rd Marine Division, which deployed to support MRF-SEA, and Philippine marines assigned to 4th Marine Brigade, patrol through terrain while participating in military operations in urban terrain training during maritime key terrain security operations in support of KAMANDAG 10 at Itbayat, Batanes islands, Philippines, June 24, 2026. US Marine Corps photo Before the rotation extension, the command element of the MRF-SEA would move between Southeast Asian countries based on where scheduled activities would take place. Since April, the command element has been based in the Philippines The current deployment is the sixth iteration of MRF-SEA. The rotational deployment began in 2022. The unit’s presence is designed to strengthen combined readiness and the U.S.-Philippine Alliance, according to a Marine Corps news release, with each rotation building on the relationships and lessons of the force before in an approach MRF-SEA calls “presence with purpose.” “Our goal was never simply to be present in the Philippines,” said Col. Robert Bunn, commanding officer of the outgoing MRF-SEA rotation. “Presence has to have purpose. Every exercise, planning session and repetition alongside our Philippine allies was an opportunity to become more interoperable, responsive and capable together, progressively getting better with each event. The next rotation now has the opportunity to take those lessons and relationships to move the alliance another step forward.” The previous rotation of MRF-SEA saw the force train alongside Philippine troops during Balikatan 26, KAMANDAG 10 and a series of bilateral events through the Archipelagic Coastal Defense Continuum (ACDC). The continuum provided recurring training between major exercises, allowing U.S. and Philippine forces to apply lessons from one event to the next. ACDC is is a series of bilateral training activities and subject matter expert exchanges that support Philippine Marine Corps modernization efforts and the Philippine Marine Corps’ Archipelagic Coastal Defense Concept along with strengthening combined readiness between U.S. and Philippine forces Training throughout the previous MRF-SEA rotation included command and control, sensing, fires integration, maritime domain awareness, aviation, communications and unmanned systems. Marines also tested how forces and equipment could move, communicate and operate across the Philippines’ distributed and archipelagic terrain. This included testing the mobility of the AN/TPS-80 Ground/Air Task-Oriented Radar as part of ACDC training and movement of the Navy-Marine Expeditionary Ship Interdiction System (NMESIS) and Marine Air Defense Integrated System (MADIS) from ports to distributed exercise locations as part of KAMANDAG 10. U.S. Marines assigned to 3rd Littoral Anti-Air Battalion, 3rd Marine Littoral Regiment, 3rd Marine Division, drive a Marine Air Defense Integrated System off a Philippine surface connector in support of maritime key terrain security operations during KAMANDAG 10 at Calayan, Philippines, June 22, 2026. US Marine Corps photo The incoming rotation will continue the progression of the U.S.-Philippine partnership through ACDC and Exercise Balikatan 27, according to the release. Training will continue to focus on operating across distributed and archipelagic terrain, strengthening the ability of U.S. and Philippine forces to coordinate, maneuver and sustain operations across geographically dispersed locations. Marines and sailors will also continue bilateral humanitarian assistance, disaster response and crisis response training. “Our Marines and sailors are inheriting more than a mission, they are inheriting momentum,” said Col. Coby Moran, commanding officer of the incoming MRF-SEA rotation. “We will build on the relationships, lessons and interoperability developed by the Marines and sailors before us and continue working shoulder-to-shoulder with our Philippine allies.” Moran previously operated in the Philippines, leading a I MEF technical assistance and advisory team in April that oversaw a maritime prepositioning force offload at the Port of Cagayan de Oro, Mindanao, Philippines. The event was the first MPF offload at Mindanao, according to a Marine Corps news release at the time . The offload saw roll-on/roll-off cargo ship USNS Sgt. William W. Seay (T-AKR-302) transport vehicles and equipment to I MEF, which was preparing for Exercise Balikatan 26 in the Philippines. “MPF operations are a unique capability of the Marine Corps,” said Moran in the release. “They allow us to deliver capabilities anywhere in the world, providing critical combat power to Marine air-ground task force commanders.” The Marine Corps has not disclosed whether MRF-SEA will now only focus on the Philippines or whether it will continue leading Marine Corps engagement and activities with other countries in the region alongside its activities in the Philippines.

新报告揭中共海外警站全球扩张 侨联成关键中介(图) 镇压公式 | 海外警务 | 跨国镇压 | 保护卫士 | 美洲 || 看中国网
2022年10月28日，人权组织“保护卫士”称，中共在伦敦设立了一个秘密的“海外警察服务站”。图为该服务站的大致位置。报告列出了伦敦、格拉斯哥以及全球其他几个城市的此类服务站。（图片来源：Leon Neal／Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月7日讯】（看中国记者李亭综合报道）2026年11月，人权组织“保护卫士”发布《镇压公式》报告称，中共海外“警察站”2022年曝光后并未关闭，反而以“侨联”等统战系统为中介持续扩张，把国内网格化管控体系输出海外。报告已查明近1250个联络点，遍及近百个国家和地区，整个华人社群被纳入监控与管控。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
2022年，该组织发布《海外110》与《巡逻与劝返》两份报告，记录了50多个国家的100多个中共海外警察站。报告发布后，多国谴责其非法运作，部分国家展开刑事调查。北京则表示这些站点已经关闭。
新报告认为，这一说法与事实不符。证据显示，目前来自中国五个省份的十多支警察力量，正通过全球性的海外执行者网络开展工作。2022年以前，警方把自己的标识挂在海外侨团门前；曝光之后，同样的工作不仅继续，还越来越多地以“侨联”的名义进行。
报告撰写者劳拉・哈特（Laura Harth）指出，这并非少数地方政府的孤立举措，而是中共一项坚定政策的组成部分，即把国内的监控与管控体系输出到世界各地。
报告说，在中国境内，每座城市、乡镇和村庄都被划分为数百户一格的网格，每格配有网格员，负责采集信息并向“社会治安综合治理中心”（综治中心）报告。综治中心是公安、检察院、法院和司法局的联合办公机构，每个县都设有一个，目的是在问题发展到党无法控制之前就将其发现并处理。
自2014年起，中共开始在海外建设同样的网格。浙江文成县的海外华侨平台“为侨服务全球通”是一例：其管控大屏显示，该县海外华侨华人168,599人，分布在70个国家，另有海外侨团联络点53个、调解员104人，并记录处置涉侨舆情41件。建设者自己的描述是，涉侨组织“一站管理”，侨务监管“一览无余”，涉侨数据“一屏掌控”。
青田县公安局局长颜华荣2019年曾公开描述其海外网络：一个照搬国内的网格，以大侨团为主干，以侨领、华侨党员和海外警务联络员为支点，由信息员与警方“点对点单线对接”，使警方能掌握关注对象的行踪并部署应对。他还称，该网格曾成功处置15起华侨计划在领导人出访时抗议的事件。
报告还列举多个案例：青田法院通过海外联络员找到旅居西班牙的被执行人，联系其亲属并告知将采取吊销护照等措施，迫使其一次性支付87万元；2022年3月，一名福州公安官员向纽约一处警察站的运营者发送一名民运人士的出生日期和前雇主信息，指示其“确认其所在位置”，该经办人于2026年5月被定罪。
报告指出，海外华侨华人事务属于党务而非政府事务，主管机构是中共中央统战部，日常工作由中华全国归国华侨联合会（侨联）及其地方组织承担。侨联在国内拥有28,663个地方组织，每个都被要求与海外侨团对接；中共称其海外关联侨团达“数万家”。
2022年曝光后，唯一改变的是联络点的名称：警察标识被摘下，管控功能依旧，覆盖范围反而更广。2026年4月，福州市统战部门一名官员称，当地侨联已“建立侨检、侨税、警侨协作机制”。两个月后，福州市侨联主席在伦敦向一个侨团颁发“海外联谊协作单位”聘书，而该侨团正是2022年曾承办福州两个伦敦警察站之一的组织。
报告统计，已查明的海外联络点由2015年底的73个增至2025年底的1,178个，十年间从每年寥寥数个增至每年一百多个，总数达1,247个，涉及近百个国家和地区。其中724个有具体地点，其余523个仅见于中国当局自己的统计数字。报告强调，2024年和2025年新设联络点尚未在中共报告中完全显现，实际增速可能被低估。
仅自2024年底以来，就有五项国家政策要求进一步扩张。此外，詹姆斯敦基金会仅在美国、加拿大、德国和英国就梳理出2,000多个统战关联团体，在另外15个欧洲国家则至少统计出1,000个。
报告认为，这套体系侵犯他国主权，损害整个社群的权利与自由，并对国家安全构成持续威胁。根据国际法，一国只能通过驻在国接受的领事机构为海外公民办事。法国最高行政法院2026年裁定，巴黎的警察站在法国领土上充当中共机构和中国公安部的中继，其活动“就其性质而言，损害国家主权及其根本利益”。报告还引述中国外交部2021年的文字，称通过海外侨团运作的联络点在所在国面临潜在政治和法律风险。
报告强调，与通常针对个别目标的跨国镇压不同，网格把整个社群当作单位，给每个人分派角色：有人被监视，有人负责监视，所有人都被管住。
- 若本人或在华亲属受到威胁，向当地主管部门举报，人身安全面临迫切威胁时应立即报警；
- 若有人要求“留意”特定对象、收集信息、向他人在华家属传话或阻挠抗议，应三思而行，因为替外国政府执行此类任务可能构成刑事犯罪。

title: Taiwan to close representative office in Papua New Guinea, blames China
zh_title: 台湾将关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处，指责中国
source: Al Jazeera – Breaking News, World News a
summary: 台湾将关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处，指责中国政治新闻|半岛电视台分享 台湾将关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处，在社交媒体上指责中国 台湾仅与三个太平洋岛国建立了正式外交关系：帕劳、图瓦卢和马绍尔群岛 [文件：Ritchie B. Tongo/EPA] 半岛电视台员工、法新社和路透社 台湾表示将关闭其在巴布亚新几内亚的代表处，并将停止从该国购买液化天然气（LNG），并将其归咎于中国对这个南太平洋国家施加的政治压力。台湾国防部
content:
台湾将关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处，指责中国政治新闻|半岛电视台
台湾将关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处，并在社交媒体上指责中国
台湾仅与三个太平洋岛屿国家建立了正式外交关系：帕劳、图瓦卢和马绍尔群岛[文件：Ritchie B. Tongo/EPA]
半岛电视台工作人员、法新社和路透社
台湾表示将关闭其在巴布亚新几内亚的代表处，并将停止从巴布亚新几内亚购买液化天然气（LNG），并将其归咎于中国对这个南太平洋国家的政治压力。
台湾外交部周五表示，巴布亚新几内亚重申了之前的要求，要求员工在规定的期限内离开首都莫尔兹比港的办公室，并敦促关闭该办公室。
list 1 of 3特朗普在与习近平的国宴上赞扬美中友谊
list 2 of 3“混合战争”：台湾驱逐 16 艘中国船只
list 3 of 3 基利安·姆巴佩因称毛泽东为“中国独裁者”而失去中国赞助商
声明称，这些行为“反映出中国持续利用政治压力和经济影响力干涉其他国家的外交决策，打压台湾的国际空间”。
中国声称台湾是其领土的一部分，对巴布亚新几内亚7月关闭台湾驻莫尔兹比港办事处的决定表示欢迎。台北拒绝了这一举措，但办事处在此期间仍保持开放。
太平洋地区长期以来一直是中国与台湾之间的外交竞争地区。巴布亚新几内亚与中国建立了正式外交关系，但允许台湾在莫尔兹比港设立代表处。
台湾仅与三个太平洋岛国建立了正式外交关系：帕劳、图瓦卢和马绍尔群岛。它还在斐济设有代表处。只有 12 个国家与台湾保持正式外交关系。
台湾此前宣布已停止从这个南太平洋国家现货购买液化天然气，但周五该部表示也将不再与该国签署新的现货采购合同。
台湾液化天然气采购量占巴布亚新几内亚出口量的三分之一。
去年，台湾约 8% 的天然气从莫尔兹比港进口。
该部表示，台北还将终止技术合作和援助计划，“包括医疗任务、相关奖学金和人才发展计划”。

Taiwan has formal diplomatic ties with only three Pacific Islands nations: Palau, Tuvalu and the Marshall Islands [File: Ritchie B. Tongo/EPA]
By Al Jazeera Staff, AFP and Reuters
Taiwan says it is closing its representative office in Papua New Guinea and will stop buying liquefied natural gas (LNG) from the country, blaming Chinese political pressure on the South Pacific nation.
Taiwan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said on Friday that Papua New Guinea had repeated previous demands that staff leave its office in the capital, Port Moresby, within a set deadline and had pushed for ⁠its closure.

These actions “reflect China’s continued use of political pressure and economic influence to interfere in other countries’ diplomatic decisions and suppress Taiwan’s international space”, it said in a statement.
China, which claims Taiwan as part of its territory, had welcomed Papua New Guinea’s decision in July to shutter Taiwan’s office in Port Moresby. Taipei rejected the move, and the office remained open in the interim.
The Pacific has long been an area for diplomatic competition between China and Taiwan. Papua New Guinea has formal diplomatic relations with China, but it had allowed Taiwan to have a representative office in Port Moresby.
Taiwan has formal diplomatic ties with only three Pacific Islands nations: Palau, Tuvalu and the Marshall Islands. It also has a representative office in Fiji. Just 12 countries maintain formal ⁠diplomatic ties with Taiwan.
Taiwan previously announced that it had stopped spot purchases of LNG from the South Pacific nation, but on Friday the ministry said it also would no longer sign new spot purchase contracts with the country.
Taiwanese LNG purchases accounted for one-third of Papua New Guinea’s exports.
Last year, Taiwan imported about 8 percent of its natural gas from Port Moresby.
Taipei will also end technical cooperation and assistance programmes, “including medical missions, related scholarship and talent development programmes”, the ministry said.

content: 资料照片：台湾外交部长林佳龙在台北举行的新闻发布会上讲话。(2024年7月19日) 台湾外交部长林佳龙星期一(11月2日)表示，即将在深圳举行的亚太经合组织(APEC)峰会，主办方中国仅以电子邮件而不是正式信函邀请台湾，台湾已经向中国发出正式抗议；但台湾不会因为遭到歧视性待遇，就放弃参与的权利。 中国将在这个月18日-19日于广东深圳主办2026年APEC第33次领导人非正式会议，包括美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)以及全球商界领袖和国际组织负责人都将出席。 台湾外交部长林佳龙星期一表示，今年中国并未循例亲自递交邀请函，而是以电子邮件寄送，林佳龙表示，台湾已经在第一时间向中国表达抗议。 依照惯例，APEC主办国会派特使亲自递送邀请函。林佳龙表示，今年中方没有采取亲自递交的方式，而是以“电子邮件”联系台湾外交部，称谓则维持台湾的参与名称“Chinese Taipei”(中华台北)。 台湾中央社报道，林佳龙星期一在接受记者访问时表示，台湾作为APEC正式会员，过去平等参与领导人峰会，中国在争取这次主办时也承诺，会遵守APEC规章、惯例，并确保出席国家代表有平等地位和安全。 林佳龙指出，今年各种APEC相关会议，中国对台湾有一些差别待遇，台湾外交部都立即表达抗议，并争取台湾的参与权益，也与APEC所有会员经济体保持良好沟通，获得支持。 林佳龙强调，台湾不会因为中国企图施加差别待遇，就放弃参与APEC的权益，也希望中国就邀请函递送、称谓和程序，都能遵守相关规定。 台湾在1991年11月以“ Chinese Taipei”名义，与中国大陆、香港一同加入APEC，是APEC正式成员。 APEC领导人峰会从1993年开始，由于北京反对台湾总统出席，台湾通常由总统指派一名“领袖代表”参加。长期以来，APEC峰会主办国派特使到台北，向台湾总统递交邀请函，台湾总统再指派代表出席。不过具体做法随主办国不同和两岸关系发展而有变化。 2001年中国在上海主办APEC峰会，北京向台北发出传真通知，而不是派特使递交正式邀请，随后北京拒绝了时任台湾总统陈水扁选定的代表，卸任副总统李元簇，台湾因此没有派代表出席当年的领导人峰会。 2014年中国再次主办峰会，时任台湾总统为马英九。中国派出国台办副主任龚清概到台北，向时任台湾陆委会主委王郁琦递交邀请。 今年，台湾外交部长林佳龙证实已经收到中方邀请，但邀请函是以“电子邮件”发出，台湾已经向主办方提出抗议。但表示不会因此放弃参与。 过去几个月，两岸关系因中国的灰色地带侵扰持续紧张。中国加大在台湾附近海域的军事与海警活动，台湾方面10月底也报告侦测到多批中国军机和舰船。 台湾中央社报道，台湾陆委会副主委沈有忠星期一在台北出席亚洲政经与和平交流协会举行的一场研讨会上表示，预计中国在五中全会后，可能加大对台湾的灰色地带施压，频繁使用海警船、科研船、民兵船等非正规军事力量，在不引发全面军事冲突的前提下，挑战台日菲等区域民主国家在这片海域的管辖权和执法权，企图逐步改变国际航行自由的现状。 上个月20日，中国海警船进入东沙海域限制水域，台湾派出海巡舰艇监控并进行驱离。 美国国务院对此向美国之音表示，中国的行为是蓄意的胁迫和破坏稳定的(intentionally coercive and destabilizing)。国务院发言人指出，中国在台湾和平管辖了70多年的海域周边宣示权威，只会加剧紧张局势，破坏地区和平与安全。

2026 年 11 月 7 日 | 12:00 上午
国防部长小吉尔伯特·特奥多罗
菲律宾马尼拉——菲律宾国防部长小吉尔伯托·特奥多罗昨天表示，那些为了图方便而捍卫中国、宣扬北京虚假言论的人将会被菲律宾人民知道。
特奥多罗表示，公众了解真相的脚步是无法阻止的。
他在 True FM 上表示：“真相终将获胜，（某些人）的信誉将受到损害。”他补充说，由于透明度倡议，中国的善意和诚意将受到菲律宾舆论的考验。
他说，中国的捍卫者应该选择站在事实一边，维护仲裁裁决。
他说，这一切都归结为仲裁裁决无效且没有法律效力的九段线。
“如果你为了方便而提出虚假的叙述，人们就会知道，总有一天会有一个会计……我的意思是，这是一个自由的世界。这是一个开放的社会，所以真相将会占上风，”他补充道。
他将中国驻马尼拉大使馆的声明及其社交媒体帖子标记为虚假信息。
“这是前所未有的。我们实际上对我们的信息负责。他们是降低级别的人，这令人担忧，”他说。
在处理局势时，秘书强调真相是无可替代的。他说：“让我们坚持事实，坚持事实。”
特奥多罗表示，菲律宾一直谨慎处理与中国的分歧，并期望北京也承担同样的责任。
他猛烈抨击中国外交部长王毅关于双边关系面临某些菲律宾政客“恶意干涉”的说法，称其为“审查威胁”。
政治联盟1Sambayan敦促菲律宾政府根据《联合国海洋法公约》对中国进行新一轮仲裁，以解决西菲律宾海的争端。
1Sambayan援引2016年有利于菲律宾并撤销中国九段线的仲裁裁决表示，菲律宾可以提起诉讼，捍卫巴拉望岛、马辛洛克和阿云金浅滩以西的扩展大陆架。
该联盟周三表示：“这个国家应该从当前的竞争中寻求的不是海上平静的一周，而是基于法律的最终解决方案，而这样的解决方案可以来自《联合国海洋法公约》仲裁庭。”
1Sambayan表示，该公约将更好地确定中国、菲律宾、越南和马来西亚对巴拉望扩展大陆架的重叠主张，而不是任何在该地区放置最多船体的国家。
该联盟还要求中国对菲律宾渔民因驱逐其传统渔场而遭受的损失承担责任。
它还通过设立海岸警卫队分站来加强海上执法，为解决阿云金浅滩持续的对峙问题提供了不同的法律途径。
该联盟强调，仲裁是每个联合国成员国都可以申请解决争端的和平手段之一。

Gibo: Filipinos will know those defending China’s false narratives
November 7, 2026 | 12:00am
Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro Jr.
MANILA, Philippines — Those defending China and advancing Beijing’s false narratives for the sake of convenience will be made known to the Filipino people, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said yesterday.
Teodoro said there’s no stopping the public from learning the truth.
“The truth will prevail and (some people’s) credibility will suffer,” he said over True FM, adding China’s good faith and sincerity are put to test by Filipino public opinion due to a transparency initiative.
China defenders, he said, should choose to side with the truth and uphold the arbitral award.
He said it all boils down to the nine-dash line which the Arbitral Award rendered void and with no legal effect.
“If you’re advancing a false narrative for the sake of convenience, the people will know and there will be an accounting someday… I mean, this is a free world. It is an open society so the truth will prevail,” he added.
He labeled as falsehood the statements of the Chinese embassy in Manila and its social media posts.
“That’s unprecedented. We actually are responsible in our messaging. They’re the ones who’ve lowered their level and that is worrisome,” he said.
In managing the situation, the secretary emphasized there is no substitute for the truth. “Let’s stick to the truth, the facts on the ground,” he said.
Teodoro said the Philippines has always been careful in managing differences with China, and expects the same kind of responsibility from Beijing.
He slammed Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi’s statement that the bilateral relationship was facing “malicious interference” by certain Filipino politicians, describing it as “a threat of censorship.”
Political coalition 1Sambayan is urging the Philippine government to pursue a new round of arbitration against China under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) to resolve disputes in the West Philippine Sea.
Citing the 2016 arbitral ruling that favored the Philippines and undid China’s nine-dash line, 1Sambayan said the Philippines can file a case to defend the extended continental shelf west of Palawan, Bajo de Masinloc and Ayungin Shoal.
“What this country should seek from the present contest is not a quieter week at sea but a definitive resolution grounded in law – and such a resolution can come from an UNCLOS arbitral tribunal,” the coalition said on Wednesday.
The convention, 1Sambayan said, would better determine the overlapping claims of China, the Philippines, Vietnam and Malaysia in the extended continental shelf in Palawan, rather than any state that has placed the most hulls in the area.
The coalition also demanded that China be held accountable for the damages suffered by Filipino fisherfolk as a result of its efforts to drive them away from their traditional fishing grounds.
It also offered a different legal approach in addressing the continuing standoff at Ayungin Shoal through the installation of a Coast Guard sub-station to enhance maritime law enforcement.
The coalition underscored that arbitration is among the peaceful means every UN member-state can apply to settle disputes.
“This is not an alternative to standing our ground. It is how a country of our size stands it,” said 1Sambayan. “The law is how we keep it.” — Andrew Ronquillo

VP Sara 启程前往香港 |菲尔星网
关于我们 |联系我们 |广告 |隐私政策 |会员协议|版权声明
版权所有 © 2026. Philstar Global Corp. 保留所有权利
2026 年 11 月 7 日 | 12:00 上午
2026 年 9 月 5 日，菲律宾副总统萨拉·杜特尔特（前右）在马尼拉郊区奎松市交保释后离开法庭。
菲律宾马尼拉——副总统萨拉·杜特尔特昨天启程前往香港，预计她将在香港停留至 11 月 8 日，一天后，她的辩护团队将在针对她的弹劾审判中开始出示证据。
OVP 在周五的一份声明中表示：“副总统办公室谨向公众通报，副总统萨拉·杜特尔特将于 2026 年 11 月 6 日至 8 日前往香港，出席各种活动，包括由菲律宾社区组织的活动。”
OVP 补充说，杜特尔特能够从奎松市地区审判法院第 98 分院获得 2026 年 11 月 3 日的命令，批准其计划出国旅行。
杜特尔特正面临司法部向奎松市 RTC 提起的严重威胁案件。
针对杜特尔特的案件源于她 2024 年 11 月的在线新闻发布会，其中她表示，如果她本人被杀，她已雇人杀死马科斯总统、第一夫人丽莎·马科斯和前议长马丁·罗穆阿尔兹。
“同样，总统办公室也颁发了相应的旅行授权，”OVP 补充道。
OVP 保证杜特尔特将使用个人资金支付她的旅行费用。声明称：“任何政府资金、资源或设施不得用于她的旅行。”
辩护阵营要求参议院弹劾法庭传唤 24 名证人，以便于 11 月 9 日恢复杜特尔特弹劾审判。弹劾法庭发言人 Reginald Tongol 宣布了将在下周全天听证会上作证的证人姓名。
与此同时，OVP 否认其遭受了涉及约 10 GB 文档的数据泄露。
网络安全倡导组织 Deep Web Konek 表示，所谓的数据泄露事件出现在一个地下网络犯罪论坛上，这名名为 DeathNoteHackers 的黑客声称已获得与 OVP 调度平台相关的约 10 GB 文档，OVP 对此做出了反应。
OVP 表示：“副总统办公室希望澄清，最近报告中提到的调度平台不是政府网站。”他补充说，该平台不包含政府机密文件或机密政府信息。
它补充说：“因此，任何涉及该平台的涉嫌数据泄露不应自动被解释为对任何政府信息的破坏或损害。”
OVP 表示，“围绕这些指控的时间和情况引发了人们的担忧，人们担心这个问题可能是出于更广泛的政治动机而抹黑副总统和办公室的一部分。”

VP Sara leaves for Hong Kong | Philstar.com

November 7, 2026 | 12:00am
Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte (front R) leaves court after posting bail in Quezon City, suburban Manila on September 5, 2026.
MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte left for Hong Kong yesterday where she is expected to stay until Nov. 8, a day before her defense team starts to present evidence in the ongoing impeachment trial against her.
“The Office of the Vice President respectfully informs the public that Vice President Sara Duterte will travel to Hong Kong from Nov. 6 to 8, 2026, to attend engagements and participate in various activities, including an event organized by the Filipino community,” the OVP said in a statement on Friday.
The OVP added that Duterte was able to secure an order dated Nov. 3, 2026, from the Quezon City Regional Trial Court Branch 98, granting permission for the intended travel abroad.
Duterte is facing a grave threats case before the Quezon City RTC filed by the Department of Justice.
The case against Duterte stemmed from her online press briefing in November 2024 wherein she said that she had hired someone to kill President Marcos, First Lady Liza Marcos and former speaker Martin Romualdez, should she herself be killed.
“Likewise, the Office of the President issued a corresponding travel authority,” the OVP added.
The OVP gave assurance that Duterte will cover the cost of her travel using personal funds. “No government money, resources or facilities shall be used in connection with her travel,” it said.
The Senate impeachment court has been asked by the defense camp to subpoena 24 witnesses for the resumption of Duterte’s impeachment trial on Nov. 9. The names of the witnesses who will testify during whole-day hearings next week have been announced by impeachment court spokesman Reginald Tongol.
Meanwhile, the OVP denied that it suffered a data leak involving approximately 10 gigabytes (GB) of documents.
The OVP was reacting after cybersecurity advocacy group Deep Web Konek said the alleged data leak surfaced in an underground cybercrime forum, where the hacker, identified as DeathNoteHackers, claimed to have obtained around 10 GB of documents associated with the OVP’s scheduling platform.
“The Office of the Vice President wishes to clarify that the scheduling platform mentioned in recent reports is not a government website,” the OVP said, adding that the platform does not contain confidential government files nor classified government information.
“Therefore, any alleged data leak involving the platform should not be automatically construed as a breach nor compromise of any government information,” it added.
According to the OVP, the “timing and circumstances surrounding the allegations raise concerns that this issue may be part of a broader politically motivated effort to discredit the Vice President and the Office.”

朝中社图片 俄罗斯和朝鲜本周进行了弹道导弹发射，根据俄罗斯国防部周三发布的消息，俄罗斯从西太平洋向俄罗斯北极地区发射了潜射弹道导弹（SLBM），而朝鲜则发射了短程弹道导弹（SRBM），作为朝鲜领导人金正恩在无人机技术展览期间进行火力演示的一部分。隶属于俄罗斯海军太平洋舰队的核动力弹道导弹潜艇（SSBN）RFS Generalissimus Suvorov（K-553）在俄罗斯西北部阿尔汉格尔斯克地区的奇扎试验场从鄂霍次克海发射了一枚RSM-56“布拉瓦”潜射弹道导弹。俄罗斯国防部周三表示：“苏沃洛夫大元帅号战略核动力弹道导弹潜艇按照作战训练计划发射了布拉瓦洲际弹道导弹。”导弹从水下位置发射，导弹弹头在预计时间成功到达指定区域。俄罗斯国防部还发布了官方媒体塔斯社转载的发射视频。尽管针对 10 月 25 日至 31 日期间进行的导弹活动发出了国际航行警告，但俄罗斯国防部并未说明发射时间。
据美国海军学院新闻报道，俄罗斯在 10 月至 11 月期间定期从俄罗斯远东地区进行潜射弹道导弹发射，苏沃洛夫大元帅于 2022 年 11 月 3 日发射了“布拉瓦”导弹，并于当年 12 月 29 日投入使用。俄罗斯上一次通过弹道导弹核潜艇发射潜射弹道导弹是在今年 5 月 21 日，当时一艘水下的 Delta IV 级弹道导弹核潜艇发射了一枚 R-29RMU Sineva 潜射弹道导弹，作为其战略核力量演习的一部分。今年仅公开披露过两次潜射弹道导弹发射，中国于 7 月从南海向南太平洋发射了一次潜射弹道导弹，法国于 10 月初进行了一次发射，从法国菲尼斯泰尔海岸向北大西洋偏远地区发射了一枚潜射弹道导弹。与俄罗斯的潜射弹道导弹在本国领土着陆和法国的潜射弹道导弹在距海岸线数百公里的北大西洋着陆不同，中国因将该地区用作潜射弹道导弹试验场而受到南太平洋岛国和其他国家的批评。朝鲜周四发射了 KN-25 600 毫米多管火箭弹（属于短程弹道导弹），作为朝鲜领导人金正恩出席的无人机技术展览期间火力演示的一部分。韩国参谋长联席会议周四表示，朝鲜于中午 12 点 30 分从元山向日本海发射了 10 枚短程弹道导弹（SRBM）。当地时间，联合参谋长联席会议还表示，短程弹道导弹的飞行距离为250公里。
日本防卫省周四报道称，朝鲜当天中午12点36分发射了一枚弹道导弹，估计弹道导弹落在朝鲜半岛东海岸附近。 JSC 和 MOD 均表示，美国、日本和韩国正在共享信息并分析此次发射。与此同时，美国太平洋司令部在声明中称发射的弹道导弹数量为两枚。周五，官方媒体朝中社报道称，金正恩周四参观了“2026年无人机技术发展”展览，该展览展示了朝鲜的无人机能力

【原文 English Original】
KCNA image Russia and North Korea carried out ballistic missile launches this week with Russia conducting a launch of a Submarine-Launched Ballistic Missile (SLBM) from the Western Pacific to Russia arctic region, according to a Russian Ministry of Defence (MOD) release on Wednesday while North Korea carried out launches of Short-Range Ballistic Missiles (SRBMs) as part of a firepower demonstration for North Korea leader Kim Jong Un during an exhibition of unmanned aerial vehicle technology. Nuclear powered ballistic missile submarine (SSBN) RFS Generalissimus Suvorov (K-553), assigned to the Russian Navy Pacific Fleet, launched a RSM-56 Bulava SLBM from the sea of Okhotsk at the Chizha test site in the Arkhangelsk region of northwest Russia. “The strategic nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine Generalissimus Suvorov launched a Bulava intercontinental ballistic missile in accordance with the combat training plan,”the Russian MOD said on Wednesday. The missiles were fired from a submerged position and the missile’s warheads successfully reached the designated area at the estimated time. The Russian MOD also released a video of the launch that was carried by state media TASS. The Russian MOD did not state when the launch took place though international navigational warnings were issued on missile activity being carried out from Oct. 25-31. Russia has regularly carried out SLBM launches from the Russian Far East during the October to November with Generalissimus Suvorov firing a Bulava on Nov. 3 2022 prior to being commissioned on Dec. 29 that year, reported USNI News. Russia last carried out an SLBM launch by a SSBN on May 21 this year when a submerged Delta IV class SSBN launched an R-29RMU Sineva SLBM as part of an exercise of its strategic nuclear forces. There has been only two other publicly disclosed SLBM launches this year, with China carrying out a launch in July from the South China Sea into the South Pacific and France carrying out one in early October , launching an SLBM from off the coast of Finistère, France into a remote area of the North Atlantic. Unlike Russia, where the SLBM landed in national territory and France, where it landed in the North Atlantic, several hundred kilometers from any coastline, China was criticised by South Pacific island states and other countries for using the area as an SLBM test site. North Korea on Thursday conducted firings of its KN-25 600mm multiple launch rockets, which are classed as SRBMs, as part of a firepower demonstration during an exhibition of UAV technology that was attended by North Korea leader Kim Jong Un. South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff on Thursday stated that North Korea launched 10 short range ballistic missiles (SRBMs) from Wonsan into the Sea of Japan at 12.30 p.m. local time, the JCS also said the SRBMs flew for a distance of 250km. Japan’s Ministry of Defense (MOD) reported on Thursday that North Korea launched a ballistic missile at 12.36 p.m. that day and it was estimated that the ballistic missile landed near the east coast of the Korean Peninsula. Both the JSC and MOD stated that the U.S., Japan and South Korea were sharing information and analysing the launches. U.S. Pacific Command’s meanwhile placed the number of ballistic missiles launched at two in its statement . On Friday, state media Korean Central News Agency reported that Kim visited the Unmanned Aeronautical Technology Development-2026 exhibition on Thursday, which showcase North Korea’s UAV capabilities and advancements. KCNA did not state the location of the exhibition though it was likely in Wonsan given the SRBM launches from the area on Thursday matched what was fired during the firepower demonstration. In his speech at the exhibition, Kim called on North Korea to seize absolute superiority in drone technology and urged North Korean scientists to go all out in obtaining miraculous results in research on UAV and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for national defence. After touring the exhibition, the North Korean leader witnessed a firepower demonstration that involved strikes on islet target by various tactical suicide attack drones, tactical cruise missiles, multi-purpose drones and a 600mm-calibre Multiple Rocket Launcher (MRL) battalion. KCNA also reported that the demonstration also involved the first publicly displayed firing of a 600mm-calibre ultra-precision MRL called ‘Sniper’. The rockets fired by North Korea’s KN-25 MRL are classed as SRBMs and North Korea has claimed they can be fitter with nuclear warheads. Imagery by KCNA, showed salvo firings by a dozen launchers. KCNA also released images showing UAVs launching missiles and loitering munitions hitting targets with some of the targets made to look like South Korean outpost and K9 Thunder Self-Propelled Howitzers and U.S. M1 Abrams tanks. KCNA images also showed Kim looking at racks of First Person View (FPV) Small Unmanned Aerial Systems (SUASs) and a new flying wing stealth design UAV not previously seen. The state media did not report or provided any details on the UAVs shown. It is unclear as to whether the flying wing UAV was an operational UAV or a model representing an actual in service UAV or one under development.

title: 美日韩外长在G20外长会议间隙举行三方会谈，再度确认台海和平稳定重要性
summary: 资料照片：美国国务卿马尔科·卢比奥在纽约联合国大会期间会见日本外相茂木敏充(Motegi Toshimitsu)(右)和韩国外交部长赵显(Cho Hyun)(左)，三国外长在会后发表联合声明。(2026年9月21日) 华盛顿 — 美国、日本与韩国外长上星期五(10月30日)在亚特兰大举行的20国集团(G20)外长会议期间举行三方会谈。美国国务院说，三方外长在会中再次强调了维持台海和平稳定的重要性；美国国务卿马科尔·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)也在会中提到，中国在南中国海、
content: 资料照片：美国国务卿马尔科·卢比奥在纽约联合国大会期间会见日本外相茂木敏充(Motegi Toshimitsu)(右)和韩国外交部长赵显(Cho Hyun)(左)，三国外长在会后发表联合声明。(2026年9月21日) 华盛顿 — 美国、日本与韩国外长上星期五(10月30日)在亚特兰大举行的20国集团(G20)外长会议期间举行三方会谈。美国国务院说，三方外长在会中再次强调了维持台海和平稳定的重要性；美国国务卿马科尔·卢比奥(Marco Rubio)也在会中提到，中国在南中国海、东中国海及黄海的胁迫行为，以及与俄罗斯的合作都是在破坏印太地区的和平稳定。 旨在为下个月在美国佛罗里达州迈阿密举行的20国集团领导人峰会铺垫的外长会议，讨论议程包括航行自由、能源、粮食及供应链安全的议题。 美国国务院在当天发布的声明中说，卢比奥与日本外相茂木敏充(Motegi Toshimitsu)及韩国外长赵显(Cho Hyun)在会议间隙进行了三方会谈，“审视了促进自由开放印太地区安全与繁荣的三边伙伴关系”，并签署了一个“三边北极太平洋伙伴关系(TAPP)”合作备忘录，以探索在太平洋北极地区的海洋合作与经济伙伴关系。 声明指出，国务卿与两位外长重申他们致力于实现朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的完全无核化，并全面执行联合国安理会各项决议，包括禁止为朝鲜核计划及弹道导弹项目提供创收支持。 “他们也强调了维护台海和平稳定的重要性。卢比奥国务卿也提出了中国寻求在南中国海确立控制权的举措、其在东中国海及黄海的胁迫行为，以及俄罗斯与中国损害印太地区和平稳定的合作，”声明说。 三国外长前一次会谈是在9月21日联合国大会期间，当时三方会谈后也曾发布联合声明，强调维系台海和平稳定的重要性。 国务院说，此次三人再度确认了该次会面时发布的共同声明，并承诺将继续在所有级别开展三方会谈。 台湾外交部上星期六发布声明表示，外长林佳龙对三国外长再次确认台海和平稳定重要性表达感谢，并欢迎伙伴国家持续透过具体行动维护区域整体和平稳定。 “美日韩三国外长今年已多次公开重申维护台海和平稳定的重要性，充分彰显台海安全攸关区域稳定，已是国际社会高度关切的共同议题，更是维系印太区域和平与繁荣不可或缺的一环，”声明说。 台湾外交部强调，面对中国持续升高对台军事威胁及灰色地带侵扰，台湾将持续与美国及其他理念相近国家深化合作，共同维护台海及印太地区的和平、稳定与繁荣。

title: ACM Research Announces Shipment of Its First 310 × 310 mm Ultra ECP ap-p Panel-Level Horizontal Electroplating Production Tool
zh_title: ACM Research 宣布发货其首款 310 × 310 mm Ultra ECP ap-p 面板级水平电镀生产工具
summary: 半导体和先进封装应用晶圆加工解决方案供应商 ACM Research, Inc. 今天宣布向中国大陆以外的亚洲客户发货其首个 310 × 310 mm Ultra ECP ap-p 面板级水平电镀生产系统。此次发货标志着 ACM 核心面板级技术的又一重大进步，也是在拓宽其多产品平台和扩大全球客户影响力方面向前迈出的重要一步。随着先进封装技术的不断发展，面板级加工越来越受到关注
content:
半导体和先进封装应用晶圆加工解决方案供应商 ACM Research, Inc. 今天宣布向中国大陆以外的亚洲客户发货其首个 310 × 310 mm Ultra ECP ap-p 面板级水平电镀生产系统。此次发货标志着 ACM 核心面板级技术的又一重大进步，也是在拓宽其多产品平台和扩大全球客户影响力方面向前迈出的重要一步。随着先进封装技术的不断发展，面板级处理因其适应更大基板的能力而在整个行业中受到关注。电镀是先进封装制造中最关键的步骤之一，其中设备稳定性、镀层厚度均匀性和一致性对于成功的工艺集成、产品良率和制造效率至关重要。新发货的工具专为 310 × 310 mm 面板级应用而设计，展示了 ACM 根据客户要求快速推进产品开发的能力。在此之前，ACM 首款 515 × 510 mm 研发工具于去年发货，突显了 ACM 将技术突破快速商业化至规模生产的能力。 “这是 ACM 先进封装工作的一个重要里程碑，标志着我们向亚洲客户交付了世界上第一个 310 × 310 毫米面板级水平电镀生产工具，”ACM 博士说。
ACM Research 总裁兼首席执行官 David Wang 表示：“我们相信，我们专有的水平电镀技术具有独特的优势，能够实现跨多种面板尺寸和新兴封装架构的下一代先进半导体封装。随着人工智能推动日益复杂的封装要求，我们看到了 ACM 在这个快速发展的市场中发挥推动作用的重要长期机会。” Ultra ECP ap-p 系统采用 ACM 专有的水平电镀技术，支持铜 (Cu)、镍 (Ni)、锡银 (SnAg) 和金 (Au) 电镀工艺。其铜电镀室采用专为高铜柱应用设计的高速电镀桨，能够在高电镀速率下为 300 微米铜柱实现良好的芯片内均匀性。该系统还具有四面密封干接触吸盘，可提高可靠性；单元内冲洗功能可最大限度地减少不同电镀单元之间的化学交叉污染；水平电镀设计采用 ACM 正在申请专利的技术，使吸盘的旋转与旋转矩形电场同步，从而实现卓越的沉积均匀性。除了设备交付之外，ACM 还致力于通过提供高质量设备、支持可靠的批量生产和提供可靠的技术支持来建立长期的客户关系。
ACM将继续推进技术进步，拓展多产品平台，扩大全球客户群。ACM旨在通过与全球合作伙伴的合作，支持人工智能行业的发展，并以其差异化的半导体设备技术为客户创造更大的价值。 ACM Research 宣布其首款 310 × 310 mm Ultra ECP ap-p 面板级水平电镀生产工具发货的消息首先出现在《半导体文摘》上。

【原文 English Original】
ACM Research, Inc. , a supplier of wafer processing solutions for semiconductor and advanced packaging applications, today announced the shipment of its first 310 × 310 mm Ultra ECP ap-p panel-level horizontal electroplating production system to a customer in Asia outside mainland China. The shipment marks another significant advance in ACM’s core panel-level technologies and represents an important step forward in broadening its multi-product platform and expanding its global customer presence. As advanced packaging technologies continue to evolve, panel-level processing is gaining traction across the industry for its ability to accommodate larger substrates. Electroplating is one of the most critical steps in advanced packaging manufacturing, where equipment stability, plating thickness uniformity and consistency are essential to successful process integration, product yield and manufacturing efficiency. The newly shipped tool is designed for 310 × 310 mm panel-level applications, and demonstrates ACM’s ability to quickly advance product development per customer requirements. This follows last year’s shipment of ACM’s first 515 × 510 mm R&D tool, highlighting ACM’s ability to rapidly commercialize technical breakthroughs into scale production. “This is an important milestone for ACM’s advanced packaging efforts, and marks shipment of what we believe is the world’s first 310 × 310 mm panel-level horizontal electroplating production tool to a customer in Asia,” said Dr. David Wang, President and Chief Executive Officer of ACM Research. “We believe our proprietary horizontal plating technology is uniquely positioned to enable the next generation of advanced semiconductor packaging across multiple panel sizes and emerging packaging architectures. As AI drives increasingly complex packaging requirements, we see a significant long-term opportunity for ACM to play an enabling role in this rapidly evolving market.” The Ultra ECP ap-p system features ACM’s proprietary horizontal electroplating technology and supports copper (Cu), nickel (Ni), tin-silver (SnAg) and gold (Au) plating processes. Its copper plating chamber incorporates a high-speed plating paddle specifically designed for tall copper pillar applications, capable of achieving good within-die uniformity for 300-micron copper pillars at high plating rates. The system also features a four-sided sealing dry contact chuck for improved reliability, in-cell rinse functionality to minimize chemical cross-contamination between different plating cells, and a horizontal electroplating design that uses ACM’s patent-pending technology to synchronize the rotation of the chuck with a rotating rectangular electric field for superior deposition uniformity. Beyond equipment delivery, ACM is committed to building long-term customer relationships by providing high-quality equipment, supporting reliable volume production and delivering reliable technical support. ACM will continue to advance its technologies, expand its multi-product platform and grow its global customer base. Through collaboration with partners worldwide, ACM aims to support the growth of the AI industry and create greater value for customers with its differentiated semiconductor equipment technologies. The post ACM Research Announces Shipment of Its First 310 × 310 mm Ultra ECP ap-p Panel-Level Horizontal Electroplating Production Tool appeared first on Semiconductor Digest .

title: 以「国安」为名的恐同攻击

content: 陈延年 国际社会主义道路（ISA） 当前，台湾同志权利面临日益严峻攻击。极右翼组织台联党于去年12月2日发表政策顾问社论，利用民众对中共的恐惧，散播「中国来台男同婚占九成」的假消息，将跨国同婚抹黑为让「中共渗透」的「国安危机」。 尽管民进党政府在随后澄清，自2024年开放两岸同婚以来，仅有130对伴侣结婚，且女同志更多。民进党对于台联党攻击同志平权的抹黑攻击，民进党极其驯服，仅止于数据交代，从未严厉谴责，深怕得罪与台联党持同样立场的亲绿右翼支持者。这再次暴露了民进党为巩固政权，不惜牺牲性别平权与民主权利的本质（参见第77期《社会主义者》「争取性别平等的斗争：为什么民进党并非站在我们这边」）。 蓝白恐同本色 为避免流失右翼选票，民进党政府急忙强调将以「国安」为由，强化对跨国伴侣的审查。然而，我们没理由相信，从未真正保护劳工免于过劳死与职灾威胁的亲资政党们，如民进党和台联。他们口中的「国安」从非保护人民安全，而是为了掩护其打压同志及剥夺群众民主权利的行径。 此外，民进党政府去年12月预告修改《体位区分标准》，原版草案本来要强迫间性人与「未经性别重置手术」的跨性别女性服兵役，民进党一度采纳了极右势力的说法，以巩固权力，他们将跨性别女性认同抹黑为「逃兵手段」。后来，由于进步群体的反弹民进党才打消。 然而多数跨性别者根本没有机会在服役年龄前获得「诊断书」，以让她们得以免除兵役。 台联党早在去年10月的声明中就利用民众对中共的恐惧，并散播亲军国主义的意识形态，诬陷过跨女认同是逃避兵役的手段，这种做法故意无视了军队体制中严重的父权色彩与性骚扰频传的事实，更遑论强迫剪发等否定性别认同的体制压力，这必将造成长期的心理创伤。——由大商家权贵把持的政府，为了用军国主义转移焦点，让群众为这个剥削且压迫的制度继续流血，极度仰赖右翼民族主义者，因为他们用国安包裹压迫。 面对绿营势力对同志的攻击，国民党与民众党选择沉默，因为若公开反对，将疏离其保守的恐同支持者；若公开支持，则会无法与民进党区隔、暴露亲军国主义真面目，进而疏离那些因反对民进党滥用战争威胁才「别无选择」靠向蓝营的群体。 蓝白恐同劣迹斑斑。国民党曾扬言若完全执政将取消同婚；党主席郑丽文也早已放弃公开支持同婚。民众党主席柯文哲则曾在公投中对同婚投下反对票，并提拔「反同大将」李国宪担任要职。蓝白为了与民进党竞逐，把国安的概念换成和平修辞和与中共谈判的幻想。 社群媒体Dcard上一名使用者揭露，成功岭替代役新训期间，只是因为发现性行为，高层就展开了全连强迫出柜的性倾向调查，而执行该调查的正是军事独裁保留至今的宪兵，以恐同肃整军队就是他们眼中的「秩序」，反观若有异性恋性行为根本不会展开「你是异性恋吗？」如此全面调查。 反对迎合军国主义 沃草与妇女新知等民团主张将「多元视角纳入民防」视为国安战略，这种论述极其危险，因为当前的「国安」与「民防」概念，在现实中是强化资本统治与军国主义的工具，所谓的「多元参与」势必沦为动员弱势群体为军国主义服务的工具，这将进一步加深对女性、身障者及劳工的现有压迫。 当前统治阶级以「全民防卫」之名，将战争准备正常化，动员LGBT+、女性与劳动群众作为炮灰。平权修辞无法掩盖军国主义本质，任何包装成「友善」的征兵或全民防卫都是对群众的欺骗。 若要发挥实质成效，抵抗恐同与性别压迫，必须与反军国主义结合。劳动阶级必须独立于蓝绿白及所有亲资亲帝势力，建立自己的政治力量与群众组织，在产业与社区中对抗战争威胁与既有压迫，拒绝为任何帝国主义竞逐牺牲。 正如中东是全球前列的军事开支地区，但显然军备竞赛无法带来安全，战争源于资本主义对利润与地缘权力的争夺。唯有建设战斗性的工运与工人政党，将军费与国安预算转向公共住房、教育与医疗，并与各国劳动者团结抵抗战争机器，才能真正反对压迫，终结资本主义制造的战争。■   這篇文章 以「国安」为名的恐同攻击 最早出現於 中国劳工论坛 China Worker 。

title: Hanwha Philly Shipyard to Build Navy Landing Ship Mediums

content:
据船舶建造经理周五发布的公告称，LST-100 韩华费城造船厂已赢得价值 2.69 亿美元的合同，用于建造海军陆战队中型登陆舰。 TOTE Services 在 7 月份赢得了价值 22 亿美元的合同，担任 LSM 船舶建造经理，并在 7 月份提出征求建议书后将合同授予韩华。 TOTE 新闻稿中写道：“韩华防务美国公司 (HDUSA) 是通过该流程选出的第一家造船商，因为其具有竞争力的定价以及对 TOTE Services 分包合同条款和条件的接受。” “该合同涵盖在韩华费城造船厂 (HPSI) 建造一艘价值 2.69 亿美元的 LSM，并可选择另外建造三艘船舶。”位于墨西哥湾沿岸的 Bollinger Shipyards 已签订建造第一艘 LSM 的合同。威斯康星州的 Fincantieri Marinette Marine 公司今年早些时候赢得了一份为四艘船提供长铅项目的合同。据该公司称，TOTE 的 LSM 合同涉及多达八艘船。新闻稿中写道：“TOTE Services 继续与 Bollinger Shipyards 和 Fincantieri Marinette Marine 进行富有成效的合同讨论，这两家船厂都根据 VCM 合同指导造船厂，预计将在建造 LSM 船队方面发挥有意义的作用。”这是海军第一次选择使用船舶建造经理来代表海军运行该计划。
USNI 新闻图片 由于海军和海军陆战队就该舰的设计和生存能力展开争论，LSM 项目多年来一直面临着需求波动。该平台是海军陆战队当前在西太平洋对抗中国战略的重要组成部分，较小的海军陆战队部队将在岛屿和海岸线之间移动，建立临时基地，从那里可以发射反舰导弹。 LSM基于Damen LST-100概念，这是一种出口导向型坦克登陆舰设计，目前在尼日利亚海军服役，也计划在澳大利亚皇家海军服役。据 USNI News 此前报道，海军以 1700 万美元的价格购买了该设计包。 TOTE 已经在管理韩华费城造船厂正在建造的另一个项目——美国海事管理局的国家安全多任务船只。去年，唐纳德·特朗普总统访问韩国后，白宫宣布了与韩国的贸易协议概要。该协议包括韩国承诺向美国造船业投资 1500 亿美元。

【原文 English Original】
LST-100 Hanwha Philly Shipyard has won a $269 million contract to build the Marine Corps’ Landing Ship Medium, according to a Friday announcement from the program’s vessel construction manager. TOTE Services, which won a $2.2 billion contract in July to function as the LSM vessel construction manager, awarded Hanwha the contract after putting out a request for proposals in July. “Hanwha Defense USA (HDUSA) is the first shipbuilder selected through that process, based on its competitive pricing and acceptance of TOTE Services’ subcontract terms and conditions,” reads a TOTE news release. “The award covers construction of one LSM, valued at $269 million, at Hanwha Philly Shipyard (HPSI), with options for three additional vessels.” Gulf Coast-based Bollinger Shipyards is already on contract to build the first LSM. Fincantieri Marinette Marine out of Wisconsin won a contract earlier this year for long lead items for four ships. TOTE’s LSM contract is for as many as eight ships, according to the company. “TOTE Services continues productive contract discussions with Bollinger Shipyards and Fincantieri Marinette Marine, both directed shipyards under the VCM contract, which are expected to play a meaningful role in building the LSM fleet,” reads the release. This is the first time the Navy has opted to use a vessel construction manager, which runs the program on behalf of the service. USNI News graphic The LSM program has faced years of requirements churn as the Navy and Marine Corps debated the ship’s design and survivability. The platform is a crucial component of the Marine Corps’ current strategy for countering China in the Western Pacific, where smaller units of Marines would move around between islands and shorelines to set up ad-hoc bases from which they could fire anti-ship missiles. The LSM is based on the Damen LST-100 concept, an export-oriented tank landing ship design currently in service with the Nigerian Navy and also planned for the Royal Australian Navy. The Navy bought the design package for $17 million, USNI News previously reported. TOTE is already managing another program under construction at Hanwha Philly Shipyard – the U.S. Maritime Administration’s National Security Multi-Mission Vessel. Last year, the White House announced the outlines of a trade deal with South Korea following President Donald Trump’s visit to the country. That deal included a pledge from South Korea to put $150 billion into American shipbuilding.
